findings.title: The placeholder check runs only on the two shipped valid examples, so a real document that is still template boilerplate validates against the schema.
findings.evidence: docs/00-working/framework/05-schemas/check_schemas.py:61-69 (PLACEHOLDER_FREE lists only requirement.valid.md and plan.valid.md). requirement.template.md with only code, created and the H1 title filled in: schema errors [], while PLACEHOLDER.findall finds 9 markers.
findings.consequence: A reused template can pass the family's check while still carrying placeholder text; only the raw template is rejected, through its front-matter patterns. REQ-024 R04 as written still holds.
